svg.desc: Snapshot for anhnam26. 6 public repositories, 9 stars on owned non-fork repositories. Calendar 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-13. Updated 13 Oct 2026 (UTC+7). Two animated players pass and score in football, basketball and volleyball beneath the calendar.

svg.title: Two players, three sports, one continuous ball
svg.desc: A fixed 24-second loop: two players exchange football passes and score a goal; one guards the other during a basketball jump shot into the hoop; one sets a volleyball and the other spikes over the net. Courts crossfade and the same moving ball changes its skin between sports.

g.text: TWO PLAYERS / THREE SPORTS / ONE BALL
